note: What a server sends to put a ceiling or a floor on how fast a unit attacks. Its identifier is wider than a byte, so it travels behind the escape. The header names the unit this is about.

fields.name: useCeiling
fields.note: 1 to apply the ceiling below; 0 leaves the unit's ceiling as it was.

fields.name: useFloor
fields.note: 1 to apply the floor below; 0 leaves the unit's floor as it was.

fields.name: ceiling
fields.note: The fastest the unit may attack, where the flag says to use it.

fields.name: floor
fields.note: The slowest, where the flag says to use it.

bits.name: ceiling
bits.note: Set where the ceiling below is to be used.

bits.name: floor
bits.note: Set where the floor below is to be used.

fields.name: ceiling
fields.note: The fastest the unit may attack, where the flag says to use it.

fields.name: floor
fields.note: The slowest, where the flag says to use it.
